slides.prompt: A lavish bouquet of soft pink garden roses, peach roses and white baby's breath wrapped in kraft paper and translucent paper with a satin ribbon, lying on a dark walnut table. A single hard beam of warm late-afternoon sun cuts diagonally across the bouquet so the petals glow intensely, everything else falls into deep, almost black shadow. Razor-sharp light edges, rich saturated colour, dramatic still life like a high-contrast fine-art photograph. No people, no hands, no text.

Extreme close-up of one perfect deep red rose with tiny water droplets on its velvety petals, lit by a single narrow hard beam of warm light from the side, the petal edges glowing, the background pure deep black. Razor-sharp light, strong contrast, rich crimson, dramatic and luxurious. No people, no text.

A tall glass vase of pink peonies and pale pink roses on a modern white windowsill, a single hard golden sunbeam hits the flowers and throws a crisp, long shadow of the blooms across the wall, the rest of the room in deep shadow, a strip of deep blue sky through the window. Very high contrast, crisp shadow edges, glowing petals, clean contemporary interior. No people, no text.

caption: 20/10, ai cũng xứng đáng được tặng một bó hoa thật đẹp 💐
